verdict.rationale: cubic documents an official MCP server that users connect to their coding agent. Through it the agent can read review findings and codebase context, request PR reviews, triage scan issues, and manage subscription and seats from an MCP client. A probe confirms a dedicated MCP server docs page. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP server working, and setup details such as authentication, transport and the full tool list in the evidence.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Connect cubic's MCP server to your coding agent to read review findings and codebase context, request PR reviews, and triage PR or codebase scan issues.
You can now ask your coding agent to check your cubic subscription, manage team seats and roles, and purchase more seats without leaving your MCP client.
official MCP server documented at https://docs.cubic.dev/ide/mcp-server
